headline: Design review of signs for Harborlight Homes, Turtle Woods/Turtle Creek, SalemFive/Dunkin' Donuts, Mobil/Dunkin', Concierge Primary Care, and Rising Star Preschool.
summary: The board will review sign applications for six properties, including Harborlight Homes at 41 Pleasant Street and Mobil/Dunkin' at 44 Dodge Street. Draft minutes from 9-3-2026 will also be discussed.
